subject: English
question_text: Make six sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below: 1 6 =
stimulus: Punctuality the habit of doing a thing in its exact time It is the habit of being punctual from one's childhood Nothing can be brought a good habit In a wide sense, it should form necessary for all human beings Maintaining punctuality denotes the process for proper utilization of time So, one to a conclusion without punctuality
guide_solution: (a) Punctuality is the habit of doing a thing in its exact time. (b) It is necessary for all human beings. (c) Nothing can be brought to a conclusion without punctuality. (d) In a wide sense, it is the process for proper utilization of time. (e) Maintaining punctuality denotes a good habit. (f) So, one should form the habit of being punctual from one's childhood.
